name: Borja Giménez Larraz - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the reform of the European Electoral Act – hurdles to ratification and implementation in the Member States
part_text:
The report does not change any law. It is the European Parliament's opinion. It asks all member states to approve a 2018 update to the European Union's election rules. One country, Spain, has not yet done so, so the update is not in force. The report also asks countries to adopt the optional parts, such as showing European party names on ballot papers, and urges the Council to start talks on Parliament's newer 2022 reform proposal.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The 2018 update waits for Spain's approval before it can apply.
- **Who it affects:** Voters and candidates in European elections, especially in Spain and Germany.
- **What happens next:** Spain must approve the update; the Council should open talks on the 2022 proposal.
